title: Spawns pick points away from enemies
body: main.gd _pick_spawn_away(): farthest-from-enemies among candidates (random among top third, max 3). Used for SP player, MP joins/round resets, and bot respawns (_bot_respawn_pos: own side in team modes) which used to reuse one fixed slot.

title: Rambo Bow and Chainsaw too weak
body: Bow 12 -> 100 damage (one-shot, as in Soldat); Chainsaw 3 -> 9 per 0.1 s (90 dps). Player and bot tables.

title: Hard-edged 'blank' scenery boxes
body: 270 tinted blank.bmp props on 29 maps rendered as sharp translucent squares; now a feathered GradientTexture2D (FILL_SQUARE).

title: Translate in-match HUD strings
body: hud.gd / scoreboard.gd / objective_hud.gd core strings through tr() with es/pt_BR/de/fr rows. Remaining: radio lines, bonus labels, vote prompt, streak titles.

title: What's new shows only the latest version
body: menu.gd changelog_since(): all sections since last_seen_version (max 6), first sentence per bullet.
